meta.title: Alvaro & Carito
meta.description: Alvaro and Carito are getting married on 15 May 2027 in Cartagena. Schedule, venue, RSVP and photographs.

guestPhotos.headline: Share your photographs
guestPhotos.intro: Anything you took today — the ceremony, the dancing, the quiet moments in between. They appear on the website straight away.
guestPhotos.thanks: Thank you. Your photographs are on the website now.
guestPhotos.whatsappMessage: Hi! Here are my photos from the wedding:

sections.tagline: After eleven years, a dog and four cities, we are finally doing this properly. We would love you there.

collage.alt: The two of us on the coast

sections.title: Until we say I do
sections.pastMessage: Married. Thank you for celebrating with us.

sections.title: How we got here
body: We met at a birthday neither of us wanted to go to. Alvaro was on the balcony complaining about the music; Carito had just changed it. We argued about it for an hour and have been arguing happily ever since.
Eleven years, one small stubborn dog and four cities later, we are getting married in the city where Carito grew up — a short walk from the square where we first said we would.
We would love you to be there for it.

sections.title: Schedule
sections.intro: Everything happens at Hacienda San Miguel. Come as early as you like.

items.title: Arrival
items.desc: Cold drinks and shade. Please be seated by ten to four.

items.title: Cocktails
items.desc: Canapés, photographs and the good rum.

items.title: Dinner
items.desc: Seated dinner, short speeches, we promise.

items.title: Carriages
items.desc: Taxis arranged back into the old town.

sections.title: Hacienda San Miguel
sections.note: Forty minutes from the airport. There is parking on site, and taxis are easy to find at the gate.

cards.title: What to wear
cards.body: Garden formal. Linen is your friend — it will be warm, and the ceremony is on grass, so think carefully about heels.

cards.title: Getting there
cards.body: Fly into Rafael Núñez (CTG). The venue is forty minutes from the airport and fifteen from the old town.

cards.title: Staying over
cards.body: We have held rooms at two hotels in the old town at a reduced rate. Mention our names when you book.

cards.title: The weather
cards.body: Hot and bright, around 31°C, with a chance of a short evening shower. Most of the evening is under cover.

sections.title: Will you come?
sections.body: One form per invitation, and please include everybody named on it. Tell us about anything you cannot eat while you are there.

sections.title: Send us your photos
sections.intro: Point your camera at the code below. Whatever you send lands on this page within seconds, and everybody can download it afterwards.

sections.title: The album
sections.intro: Ours to begin with, and yours as they arrive. Tap any photograph to see it full size or download it.

photos.alt: The table before everyone sat down
photos.caption: The table, before

sections.title: If you insist
sections.intro: Getting you to Cartagena is gift enough — most of you are crossing an ocean for this. But we are asked often, so:

items.name: The honeymoon
items.note: Two weeks somewhere with no signal.

items.name: The registry
items.note: A short, unromantic list of things for the flat.

items.name: Fundación Juanfe
items.note: If you would rather give it away — so would we.

items.a: Your invitation names everyone we have a seat for. If it is unclear, just ask us — it is not an awkward question.
Very. Tell us their ages on the RSVP and we will sort out food and a quiet room for later in the evening.

items.q: What time should I actually arrive?
items.a: Half past three. The ceremony starts at four exactly and the gate is a five-minute walk from the garden.
Yes, on site and free. There will also be taxis at the gate from midnight.

items.q: I cannot eat something. Is that a problem?
items.a: Not at all. Put it on the RSVP form and the kitchen will take care of it.

items.q: Where do I send my photos?
items.a: Scan the code in the Share photos section above, or send them on WhatsApp. They appear on this page immediately.

sections.quote: Come hungry, wear linen, and stay for the last song.
